#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <iomanip>

using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;

vector<int> convolve(const vector<int>& x, const vector<int>& y, int mod) {
    int len = x.size() + y.size() - 1;
    int size = max(2, 1 << (32 - __builtin_clz(len - 1)));
    
    vector<double> xr(size, 0.0), xi(size, 0.0);
    for (int i = 0; i < x.size(); i++) {
        long long v = ((long long)x[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        xr[i] = v & 0x7FFF;
        xi[i] = v >> 15;
    }
    
    auto fft = [](vector<double>& re, vector<double>& im, bool inv) {
        int n = re.size();
        int bits = 32 - __builtin_clz(n) - 1;
        vector<int> rev(n, 0);
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            rev[i] = (rev[i >> 1] >> 1) | ((i & 1) << (bits - 1));
        }
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            if (i < rev[i]) {
                swap(re[i], re[rev[i]]);
                swap(im[i], im[rev[i]]);
            }
        }
        
        for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
            int half = len >> 1;
            vector<double> cos(half), sin(half);
            double sign = inv ? -1 : 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < half; i++) {
                double angle = 2 * M_PI * i / len * sign;
                cos[i] = cos(angle);
                sin[i] = sin(angle);
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
                for (int j = 0; j < half; j++) {
                    double wR = cos[j];
                    double wI = sin[j];
                    double uR = re[i + j];
                    double uI = im[i + j];
                    double vR = re[i + j + half] * wR - im[i + j + half] * wI;
                    double vI = re[i + j + half] * wI + im[i + j + half] * wR;
                    
                    re[i + j] = uR + vR;
                    im[i + j] = uI + vI;
                    re[i + j + half] = uR - vR;
                    im[i + j + half] = uI - vI;
                }
            }
        }
        
        if (inv) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                re[i] /= n;
                im[i] /= n;
            }
        }
    };
    
    fft(xr, xi, false);
    
    vector<double> yr(size, 0.0), yi(size, 0.0);
    for (int i = 0; i < y.size(); i++) {
        long long v = ((long long)y[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        yr[i] = v & 0x7FFF;
        yi[i] = v >> 15;
    }
    fft(yr, yi, false);
    
    vector<double> resR(size, 0.0), resI(size, 0.0);
    vector<double> tmpR(size, 0.0), tmpI(size, 0.0);
    
    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        int j = (size - i) & (size - 1);
        
        double a1r = (xr[i] + xr[j]) * 0.5;
        double a1i = (xi[i] - xi[j]) * 0.5;
        double a2r = (xi[i] + xi[j]) * 0.5;
        double a2i = (xr[j] - xr[i]) * 0.5;
        
        double b1r = (yr[i] + yr[j]) * 0.5;
        double b1i = (yi[i] - yi[j]) * 0.5;
        double b2r = (yi[i] + yi[j]) * 0.5;
        double b2i = (yr[j] - yr[i]) * 0.5;
        
        resR[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
        resI[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;
        tmpR[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i;
        tmpI[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r;
    }
    
    fft(resR, resI, true);
    fft(tmpR, tmpI, true);
    
    vector<int> out(len, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        long long a = llround(resR[i]);
        long long b = llround(tmpR[i]);
        long long c = llround(resI[i]);
        out[i] = (int)((a + ((b % mod) << 15) + ((c % mod) << 30)) % mod);
    }
    return out;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int N, K;
    cin >> N >> K;
    
    vector<int> base(10, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        base[x] = 1;
    }
    
    vector<int> result = {1};
    int exp = N / 2;
    
    while (true) {
        if (exp & 1) {
            result = convolve(result, base, MOD);
        }
        exp >>= 1;
        if (exp == 0) break;
        base = convolve(base, base, MOD);
    }
    
    long long sum = 0;
    for (int val : result) {
        sum = (sum + (long long)val * val) % MOD;
    }
    cout << sum << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
